messages:
Priya (marketing): Heads up — noticed ~12 inbound leads created in HubSpot over the weekend that never made it to SF (no owner). Anyone else seeing this?
Sam (revops): yep saw the spike. looks like enrichment step errored and round‑robin failed to enqueue. example HS IDs: 84201, 84202, 84210.
Miguel (sales-eng): flagged a couple on my side — customers in EMEA, region tag dropped during enrichment. they skipped geo affinity and hit default pool which is empty.
Priya (marketing): ugh. did enrichment timeout? we pushed a TTL change last week.
Sam (revops): logs show a 504 from enrichment lambda at 10:12pm Sat, then a retry backoff that never re-enqueued to the rr queue because the "assign-owner" job checks enrichment.completed === true.
Liz (ops): quick fix idea: relax the precondition so partial enrichment (email + country) is enough for assignment, then run a backfill for leads with email but missing person. would need a patch and a short maintenance window. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Miguel (sales-eng): that sounds safe — catalog of required fields for assignment is small. can we add a guard to prevent duplicate assignments if the owner already exists post-backfill?
Sam (revops): yes — implement idempotent assign-owner using HS contact id as key. also add a one-time migration: run a scan for created_at between 2025-03-15 22:00 and 2025-03-16 04:00 and enqueue missing leads. I'll draft the script.
Priya (marketing): timeline? we have a webinar registrant flow dependent on immediate assign for SDR follow-up.
Liz (ops): can do a hotfix today (30–45m), backfill script will take ~20m for the affected window. Will coordinate a low-traffic deploy at 15:00 PST.
Priya (marketing): please add an alert to catch if enrichment takes >8s or returns 5xx so we don't miss this next time.
Sam (revops): adding a simple SLO alert: enrichment latency >8s or failure rate >1% -> #oncall and a runbook link.
hs-sync-bot: Created ticket RH-5234: "HS -> SF: enrichment timeout caused unassigned leads backfill" assigned to @Sam.
Priya (marketing): thanks team. after patch let's confirm the SLA window for handoff (we currently say <= 5m in docs). if enrichment can occasionally take longer we should make the tolerance explicit or add a fallback owner.
Miguel (sales-eng): agree. propose: if owner not assigned within 5m, route to a temporary shared queue and ping SDR lead channel. reduces lead cold-time.
Liz (ops): I'll update the runbook and Slack escalation playbook. will post the deploy ETA in this thread. :white_check_mark:
